sentences.en: Your prompt attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated.
sentences.zh: 您对这件事迅速的关注将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Sami doesn't know what prompted the teacher to do this.
sentences.zh: 萨米不知道是什么促使老师这样做。

sentences.en: Conflicting reports prompted the director to reconsider her position.
sentences.zh: 相互矛盾的报告促使导演重新考虑她的立场。
